ModMetaData.name: CombatExtended-SimpleSidearms Compatibility Patch
ModMetaData.author: eebette
ModMetaData.description:
Makes Combat Extended and Simple Sidearms play nicely together.
Covers: - Sidearm pickup limits respect CE bulk (not just weight), including the weapons Simple Sidearms fetches on its own - Weapon scoring uses CE stats (magazine, reload time, ammo damage) - Pawns never auto-switch to guns with no ammo - NPC-generated sidearms spawn loaded, with spare ammo in inventory - Simple Sidearms no longer interrupts CE reload jobs - CQC melee auto-switch works with CE melee verbs - Mid-combat ranged auto-switch works with CE shoot verbs - One-use weapon (single-shot launcher) re-equip follows Simple Sidearms preferences - CE's replacement-weapon switching (destroyed, used up, thrown) respects Simple Sidearms preferences - CE loadouts no longer drop remembered sidearms (synced to CE hold-tracking) - EMP/dangerous weapon detection reads the loaded CE ammo type
